question: Archimedes drains his tub. The graph shows water remaining: one x-unit is 1 minute and one y-unit is 50 liters. How much water was initially in the tub?
original_question:
The linear function is graphed. Archimedes drained the water in his tub.
The amount of water left in the tub (in liters) as a function of time (in minutes) is graphed.
How much water was initially in the tub?
